headline: Pennsylvania would ban AI chatbots in children's toys
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Pennsylvania would prohibit artificial intelligence chatbots in children's toys and would impose penalties on violators. Not passed. It cites the fear that children are talking to chatbots.

Six measures in five states cite the fear that cars are driving themselves.

2,250 measures tracked. 757 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
